title: Gerbang Jam Sepuluh
mood: bratty, gleeful and built to be shouted back
subject: climbing the locked boarding-house gate at eleven at night after a gig while the landlady waits on the porch with a flashlight
caption: Indonesian pop punk in the 2000s Jakarta sing-along style. Two distorted electric guitars playing palm-muted downstroked power chords in the verses and opening into octave-riff leads on the chorus; a bright keytar synth line doubling the chorus melody; picked electric bass locked to root eighths; drums playing a driving eighth-note backbeat in the verses and flipping to a fast skate-punk beat with the snare on every upbeat in the choruses, crash-ride accents and a half-time breakdown before the last chorus. Loud, tight and bright, the guitars wide left and right, the lead vocal forward and dry, the gang shouts right behind it. Bright, slightly nasal young male lead, cheeky and fast, with a gang of friends shouting 'whoa-oh' and the answer lines. 184 BPM, E major. Bratty, gleeful and built to be shouted back. No screaming, no metalcore breakdown, no emo minor-key drama, no autotune, no trap drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitars, four clicks on the hi-hat]

[Verse 1]
Manggung di kafe, dibayar nasi kotak
Encore dua kali, gue lupa lihat jam
Ojek nurunin gue di mulut gang
Gerbang kos udah digembok dari dalam

[Pre-Chorus]
Pesan Ibu Kos di grup jelas banget
"Lewat jam sepuluh, tidur di luar!"

[Chorus - gang shouts]
Whoa-oh, gerbang jam sepuluh
Gitar di punggung, sandal di tangan
Whoa-oh, gue manjat pelan-pelan
Asal Ibu Kos udah tidur, aman

[Verse 2]
Kaki kanan di gembok, kaki kiri di pot
Celana nyangkut di ujung besi pagar
Sret! Robek dari lutut sampai saku
Terus ada senter nyala di teras

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, the gang answers each line]
"Jam berapa ini?" (Jam sebelas, Bu!)
"Kamu kira ini hotel?" (Bukan, Bu!)
"Turun dari situ!" (Iya, Bu!)
"Uang kos bulan ini?" (Besok, Bu!)

[Chorus - double-time, gang shouts]
Whoa-oh, gerbang jam sepuluh
Gitar di punggung, celana robek
Whoa-oh, Ibu Kos buka gembok
"Ibu nonton live-mu. Besok pulang jam sepuluh!"

[Outro - one last power chord ringing out]
Whoa-oh, besok jam sepuluh
